描述_EN: phillip lim is a fashion designer from new york who began his fashion career with his fashion line '3.1 phillip lim' in 2005. the result is a creation of individual looks that are unexpected, unplanned, but completely relevant'. his signature is making 'beautiful clothes with added touches of madness, striving towards the imperfection. his clothing line is now represented in 26 countries worldwide. in 2007 he launched his menswear and kidswear range. also in this year he was honoured with the cdfa swarovski award for emerging talent in womenswear. this particular dress is a miniature of the womenswear version and is a gift from his company to the museum.
描述_ZN: 菲利普-林是一位来自纽约的时装设计师，他在2005年以其时装系列 "3.1菲利普-林 "开始了他的时装生涯。 其结果是创造出出人意料的、无计划的、但完全相关的个人外观。 他的标志是制作 "美丽的衣服，加上疯狂的点缀，努力追求不完美。 他的服装系列现在在全球26个国家有代理。 在2007年他推出了他的男装和童装系列。 在这一年，他被授予CDFA施华洛世奇女装新兴人才奖。 这件特别的衣服是女装版本的一个缩影，是他的公司送给博物馆的礼物。
